x11.guide_instruction_macos_install: Terma downloads and verifies the official XQuartz installer before invoking the macOS installer.
x11.guide_instruction_macos_sudo: When the terminal asks for a sudo password, enter the remote macOS account password and detect X11 applications again after installation.
x11.guide_instruction_manual_package_manager: apt, dnf, or pacman was not detected. Install xauth and common X11 applications manually according to the remote distribution.

x11.guide_instruction_redetect: After installation, return to the X11 graphical application window and detect again.
